import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 悬赏
 * 指令：/悬赏 UID/@目标 金额 [人数]
 *
 * 对指定目标悬赏，扣除灵晶（含20%手续费）
 */

import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot';
import { getBackendBountyPublishPolicy } from '@src/api/bot/bounty-actions';
import App from '@src/response-apps/bounty/publish/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { resolveTargetUidFromArg } from '@src/utils/targetUid';
import { Format, onResponse, useMention } from 'alemonjs';

const bountyHeader = [
  { label: '悬赏榜', command: '/悬赏榜' },
  { label: '杀神榜', command: '/杀神榜' }
];

const bountyFooter = [
  { label: '记录', command: '/打劫记录' },
  { label: '悬赏', command: '/悬赏' },
  { label: '仇人', command: '/仇人' },
  { label: '煞气', command: '/煞气' },
  { label: '金盆', command: '/消耗 金盆 1' }
];

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const [mention] = useMention();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const text = (e.MessageText ?? '').trim();

  const match = text.match(/^(?:!|！|\/|#|＃)?悬赏\s+(\S+)\s+(\d+)(?:\s+(\d+))?$/);

  if (!match) {
    const helpMd = Format.createMarkdown();

    try {
      const policy = await getBackendBountyPublishPolicy(bid);

      helpMd.addNewline();
      helpMd.addNewline();
      helpMd.addText('格式：/悬赏 目标UID/@目标 金额 [人数]');
      helpMd.addNewline();
      helpMd.addText(`金额上限：${policy.maxAmount} 灵晶（每人至少 ${policy.minPerPerson} 灵晶）`);
      helpMd.addNewline();
      helpMd.addText(`人数范围：${policy.minCompletions}~${policy.maxCompletions}（默认${policy.defaultCompletions}）`);
      helpMd.addNewline();
      helpMd.addText(`手续费：${policy.feePercent}%（发布即扣，不退还）`);
      helpMd.addNewline();
      helpMd.addText(`有效期：${policy.validHours}小时`);
      helpMd.addNewline();
      helpMd.addNewline();
      helpMd.addText('示例：/悬赏 123 1000 2');
    } catch {
      helpMd.addText('悬赏规则加载失败，请稍后再试');
    }

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '悬赏',
        content: helpMd,
        header: bountyHeader,
        footer: bountyFooter
      })
    );

    return;
  }

  const targetUid = await resolveTargetUidFromArg(match[1], mention);
  const amount = parseInt(match[2], 10);
  const maxCompletions = match[3] ? parseInt(match[3], 10) : undefined;

  if (!targetUid) {
    const helpMd = Format.createMarkdown();

    helpMd.addText('请提供有效的目标UID，或直接 @目标');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '悬赏', content: helpMd, header: bountyHeader, footer: bountyFooter }));

    return;
  }

  const result = await App({ bid, uid, targetUid, amount, maxCompletions, request: createBackendRequestContext(e) });
  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  switch (result.code) {
    case 'INVALID_PARAMS':
      md.addText('输入数值过大，请检查参数');
      break;
    case 'FAIL':
      md.addText(result.data.message);
      break;
    case 'OK': {
      const d = result.data;

      md.addText('悬赏发布成功');
      md.addNewline();
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText(`悬赏编号：#${d.bountyId}`);
      md.addNewline();
      md.addBlockquote(
        Format.createMarkdown()
          .addText(`支付灵晶：${d.totalCost},手续费：${d.fee}`)
          .addNewline()
          .addText(`赏金池：${d.rewardPool},每人赏金：${d.rewardPerPerson}`)
          .addNewline()
          .addText(`允许完成：${d.maxCompletions}人,有效期：${d.validHours}小时`)
      );
      break;
    }
  }

  void message.send(
    FormatGui({
      isPrivate,
      bid,
      title: '悬赏',
      header: bountyHeader,
      footer: bountyFooter,
      content: md
    })
  );

  // ── 悬赏发布群播报 ──
  if (!isPrivate && result.code === 'OK' && result.data.targetName) {
    const f = Format.create();
    const broadcastMd = Format.createMarkdown();

    broadcastMd.addText(`🎯 有人悬赏 ${result.data.targetName} 的项上人头，赏金 ${result.data.rewardPool} 灵晶！`);
    f.addMarkdown(broadcastMd);

    void message.send({
      format: f
    });
  }
});
